*F-SIG* (Digital signature) is part of *Public-Key Primitives, Key Exchange, Messaging* in the UC functionality encyclopedia. Status: a canonical, well-established UC functionality.

*References:*

- Canetti. [*Universally composable signature, certification, and authentication*](https://eprint.iacr.org/2003/239). In 17th IEEE Computer Security Foundations Workshop (CSFW), pages 219–233, 2004.
- Backes and Hofheinz. [*How to break and repair a universally composable signature functionality*](https://eprint.iacr.org/2003/240). In Information Security Conference (ISC), 2004.
- Küsters and Tuengerthal. [*Joint state theorems for public-key encryption and digital signature functionalities with local computation*](https://eprint.iacr.org/2008/006). In 21st IEEE Computer Security Foundations Symposium (CSF), pages 270–284, 2008.
